a2t_calibration_identity_hash_convention: a2t_calibration_split_identity_hash is SHA-256 over the LF-joined sorted parent 'key' values (audio2tool:<tier>:<id6>) and reproduces the parent receipt docs/receipts/probe-samples/r1-audio2tool-sample.json exactly. a2t_calibration_flight_split_identity_hash is data.splits.split_identity_hash(prefixed('audio2tool', sample_ids)) over audio2tool/<tier>:<id6>, the value core.flight.FlightRuntime.preflight computes at flight time. Both cover the same 400 samples; an exposure row must carry whichever value the code path that builds its ExecutionPlan computes.
a2t_calibration_d1_media_supplement: none, by design. All 400 sample ids are already inside the parent D1 identity closure (docs/receipts/artifacts/d1-identity.json carries exactly these 400 audio2tool media entries), and contracts.gate_media_identity refuses any supplement that duplicates a base D1 sample. Media identity is verified against the parent D1 manifest directly, so this fragment declares no d1_media_supplement / d1_media_supplement_sha256 pair.
a2t_calibration_exposure: The frozen 400 discovery split already exposed by A0 (ledger row SAEA-BASE-a2t-a0-400). Nothing is drawn here; the roster receipt only re-expresses the frozen parent receipt in the flight-roster schema and adds media_relpath, audio_seconds and audio_sha256. This fragment grants no contact authority.
a2t_calibration_no_driver_split_name: This fragment deliberately declares no split_name key. split_id names the receipt-scoped split a calibration adapter resolves from the hash-pinned roster receipt above; it is never resolved through the generic probe-receipt universe, whose 'discovery' split_role now spans 608 samples (the frozen 400 plus two 104-row post-seal AgentLoop scoring receipts).
